title: MINTEval: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.18565v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world agents operate over long and evolving horizons, where information is repeatedly updated and may interfere across memories, requiring accurate recall and aggregated reasoning over multiple pieces of information. However, existing benchmarks focus on static, independent recall and fail to capture these dynamic interactions between evolving memories. In this paper, we study how current memory-augmented agents perform in realistic, interference-heavy, long-horizon settings across diverse domains and question types. We introduce MINTEval (Long-Horizon Memory under INTerference Evaluation), a benchmark featuring (1) long, highly interconnected contexts with frequently updated information that induces substantial interference, (2) diverse domains (state tracking, multi-turn dialogue, Wikipedia revisions, and GitHub commits), enabling evaluation of domain generalization, and (3) diverse question types that assess robustness

translated_title: MINTEval：评估长时程智能体系统中多目标干扰下的记忆能力
translated_abstract: 现实世界的智能体在漫长且不断演进的时间跨度中运行，其中信息会被反复更新，并可能在多个记忆之间产生相互干扰，这要求智能体能够准确回忆并对多条信息进行聚合推理。然而，现有的基准测试专注于静态、独立的回忆任务，无法捕捉不断演化的记忆之间的这些动态交互作用。在本文中，我们研究了当前记忆增强型智能体在跨多种领域和问题类型的真实、高干扰、长时程环境中的表现。我们提出了MINTEval（长时程干扰下记忆评估），该基准具有以下特点：(1) 长且高度关联的上下文，其中信息频繁更新，从而产生大量干扰；(2) 多样化的领域（状态追踪、多轮对话、维基百科修订和GitHub提交），支持领域泛化能力的评估；(3) 多样化的问题类型，用于评估鲁棒性……
tldr: 提出MINTEval基准，通过包含频繁更新信息的长且高度关联的上下文、多样化领域任务和问题类型，系统评估记忆增强智能体在多目标干扰和长时程场景下的记忆能力。
en_tdlr: MINTEval is a benchmark that evaluates memory-augmented agents in realistic long-horizon, interference-heavy settings, featuring long highly interconnected contexts with frequently updated information, diverse domains, and varied question types.
